Refinery gas, petrol, naphtha, kerosene (paraffin), diesel oil, fuel oil, lubricating oil, bitumen.

front: Uses: refinery gas, petrol, naphtha, kerosene
back: Bottled gas for heating and cooking; car fuel; chemical feedstock; jet fuel (and paraffin).

front: Uses: diesel, fuel oil, lubricating oil, bitumen
back: Diesel engines; ships and home heating; lubricants, waxes and polishes; roads and roofing.

front: Is fractional distillation physical or chemical?
back: Physical: it separates by boiling point without making new substances.
